titulo_es: From Miño to Algarve: the regions of Portugal

Douro.consejo: River and valley of the wine of Porto.

texto: Portugal is divided into regions. The **Minho** (Miño) is in the north and is very green. The **Douro** is the valley of the wine of Porto. The **Alentejo** is south, with wide plains. The **Algarve** is the most tourist south, with beaches and cliffs.
To say where something is, use **no norte**, **no sul**, **no interior**: **Fica no norte** (it is in the north).
With regions it is said **no Minho**, **no Douro**, **no Alentejo**, **no Algarve**: **Vou ao Algarve** (I go to the Algarve). With countries or cities, it sometimes changes.

frases.en: I'm going to the Algarve in the summer.
